subject: Red Card Know Your Rights Initiative
overview: Councilor Matt Leming summarized the Medford Democratic City Committee's distribution of 'red cards' to inform migrant communities of their constitutional rights. The report addressed the legal basis for the initiative, media response, and separate City Council actions regarding sanctuary status.

items.title: Red Card Campaign Overview
items.summary: Councilor Matt Leming detailed the Red Card campaign, which provides residents with cards explaining Fourth and Fifth Amendment rights in multiple languages.

items.title: Welcoming City Ordinance Background
items.summary: The Medford City Council passed a Welcoming City Ordinance in January to establish sanctuary city status prior to the current administration taking office.

items.title: Democratic City Committee Authorization
items.summary: The Medford Democratic City Committee voted on April 7 to authorize the purchase of 4,000 cards in four languages for distribution via non-profit organizations.

items.title: Media Coverage and Public Response
items.summary: The initiative received local and national media attention, resulting in both increased card requests and reports of online harassment against committee members.

items.title: City Council Know Your Rights Initiative
items.summary: The City Council approved a separate Know Your Rights campaign on April 8, requesting that the mayor's office disseminate similar information to the community.

items.title: Constitutional Rights and Funding Concerns
items.summary: The report addressed the legal precedent for constitutional rights applying to all persons regardless of citizenship and noted policy differences between the Council and the Mayor regarding federal funding risks.
